$metadata.name: BELLA
$metadata.note: Flat rollup of primitive + semantic(light) + component. Dark mode lives in bella.css as [data-theme='dark'] overrides (semantic + mode-divergent component tokens).

ink.$description: Signature near-black with a warm plum undertone. Primary text on light surfaces; the light-mode inverse surface.

usage: High-contrast text on ground and paper
Inverse (dark) sections embedded in light pages
Light-mode link color (affordance is underline + iris hover)
dont: Do not use as body text on navy — use navy.ink instead
Do not use pure #000 — ink is warmer
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 16.06:1 on ground #F5F4EF, 16.92:1 on paper #FAFAF8, AAA everywhere on light surfaces.

ground.$description: Warm off-white. The default light-mode page background. Replaces pure white everywhere; also the parchment-era canvas, cooled one step.

usage: Text on iris fills (primary button label)
Text color on navy where navy.ink is too bright
dont: Never replace with pure #FFFFFF — warmth is part of the brand
Do not use as a card surface on ground pages — cards use neutral.paper
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: as text on iris #5B4BD1 5.66:1 (AA), on iris.deep hover #4C3EB8 7.09:1 (AAA).

navy.$description: Deep blue-violet. The dark-mode page background. Replaces the near-black ink page; dark mode is navy, not black.

usage: Text on periwinkle fills (dark primary button label)
dont: Do not use iris text on navy — 2.64:1 fails everything; the accent flips to periwinkle
Do not use as a light-mode text color
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: as text on periwinkle #A79CE2 6.65:1 (AA normal, AAA large), on periwinkle hover #B9B0E9 8.18:1 (AAA).

iris.$description: The single accent, light mode. Saturated iris violet. At body scale iris means INTERACTIVE and only that (colour affordance rule, 2026-07-17).

usage: Inline link color paired with underline
dont: Never on navy — 2.64:1 fails text AND the 3:1 non-text minimum; dark mode uses periwinkle
Never on eyebrows — wayfinding is not action
Never pair with a second accent color
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: on ground 5.66:1, on paper 5.96:1, on surface 5.25:1, AA text + AAA large + 3:1 non-text on all light surfaces; AAA normal-text fails everywhere (max 5.96:1). On navy 2.64:1, fails all thresholds, including non-text.
bella.bar: AAA-minded AA (Elleta, 2026-07-21): AA where the accent speaks; the accent always theme-flips; never on its failing ground, even as decoration.

periwinkle.$description: The accent's dark-mode form; decorative lavender tints in light mode. Iris and periwinkle are one accent seen in two modes, never two accents.

usage: Dark-mode accent text and secondary-button outline
Decorative tints in light mode via alpha washes
dont: Never as text or interactive color on light surfaces — 2.24:1 on ground fails everything, including 3:1 non-text
Never as a solid decorative block in light mode — tints only
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: on navy 6.65:1 (AA normal, AAA large), on dark card #232350 5.95:1 (AA), on dark raised #2B2B5C 5.30:1 (AA). On ground 2.24:1, on paper 2.36:1, fails every threshold on light surfaces.
bella.bar: AAA-minded AA (Elleta, 2026-07-21): AA where the accent speaks; the accent always theme-flips; never on its failing ground, even as decoration.

bright.$description: Brightened iris for hero accents on navy. Non-text and large-scale display use only.

usage: Large decorative marks in dark mode
dont: Not a text color at body scale — 3.99:1 on navy fails AA normal text
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 3.99:1 on navy, passes 3:1 non-text and AA large text only.

hi.$description: Keycap fill gradient, top stop. One step brighter than iris.

usage: Primary keycap button fill, top stop (with brand.iris as bottom stop)
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: white label on this stop 4.95:1, AA. Every fill stop under a white label must stay ≥4.5:1.

deep.$description: Darkened iris. Primary button hover fill in light mode.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: ground text on this 7.09:1, AAA.

edge.$description: Iris keycap edge. The hard bottom-edge plate of the extruded key.

usage: Keycap edge line in shadow.key-* tokens

logo-hi.$description: Brand-lockup keycap gradient, top stop. Lighter than the button fill ramp.

usage: Keycap logo (the DESIGN key) gradient top stop
dont: Never under a white label — 3.3:1 on the stop fails 4.5:1 (recorded portfolio measurement)
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 4.97:1 against navy as a non-text plate.

peri-hover.$description: Brightened periwinkle. Dark-mode primary button hover fill.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: navy text on this 8.18:1, AAA.

peri-ink.$description: Periwinkle tuned for use as TEXT on navy (accent-ink, dark mode).

usage: Accent-colored text on navy (accent-ink dark binding)
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 7.89:1 on navy, AAA.

cream.$description: Warmest near-white. Between ground and paper; occasional soft surface.

usage: Soft alternate surface where paper is too crisp
dont: Not the page background — that's ground

paper.$description: Warm white. The raised card surface in light mode, and the fixed-context paper surface that never theme-flips (reveal card, resume modal). Pure #FFFFFF stays retired.

usage: Fixed-context paper surfaces in both modes
dont: Never swap for pure white

surface.$description: Inset light surface, one step darker than ground. Wells, tracks, recessed panels.

dont: Not a card surface — cards are paper and separate by lift, not darkness

border.$description: Warm light gray. Default solid border on ground backgrounds.

dont: Not a background
Not text

graphite.$description: Dark warm gray. High-contrast border for light-mode focus and strong dividers.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 11.72:1 on ground, far above the 3:1 non-text minimum.

ink-soft.$description: Body-text ink, one step soft of brand ink. The portfolio's default reading color.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 12.81:1 on ground, AAA.

ink-muted.$description: Muted ink. Secondary text on light surfaces, still AAA.

usage: Metadata that must stay comfortably readable
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 8.33:1 on ground, 7.74:1 on surface, AAA on both.

ink-faint.$description: Faintest legible ink. Darkened one step from the fork's #757085 (bar call 2026-07-21) so it passes AA normal text on its worst ground.

dont: Never body or secondary text — muted means metadata
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21 (worst-ground-wins): 5.02:1 on ground, 4.67:1 on surface-inset #EDECE4 (worst), 5.29:1 on paper, AA normal text on every light ground. Bar: AAA-minded AA; supersedes #757085 (4.32:1, failed AA on ground).

card.$description: Raised card surface on navy. One step lighter than the page; dark elevation climbs lighter.

raised.$description: Highest dark surface. Modals and elevated panels on navy.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: navy.ink-muted on this 7.53:1, the AAA bump surface (portfolio Pass B, 2026-07-18).

divider.$description: Subtle divider on navy. Decorative separation only, 1.38:1 against navy carries no identification contrast.

dont: Never the sole boundary of an interactive component — 1.38:1 fails the 3:1 non-text minimum
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 1.38:1 on navy, decorative only.

ink.$description: Primary text on navy. Warm parchment-toned white.

usage: Body and heading text in dark mode
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 14.35:1 on navy, AAA.

ink-soft.$description: Soft reading ink on navy, the dark-mode counterpart of neutral.ink-soft.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 12.61:1 on navy, AAA.

ink-muted.$description: Muted ink on navy. The Pass B AAA bump value (2026-07-18), AAA on every dark surface.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 9.45:1 on navy, 8.45:1 on card, 7.53:1 on raised, AAA on all three.

text-secondary.$description: Semantic secondary text on navy (the vendored bella.css fork binding). Sits a hair cooler than ink-muted.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 9.20:1 on navy, 8.23:1 on card, 7.33:1 on raised, AAA on all three.

text-muted.$description: Faint metadata ink on navy. Brightened one step from the fork's #8F8AA8 (bar call 2026-07-21) so it passes AA normal text on its worst ground.

usage: Timestamps and tertiary metadata in dark mode, any dark surface
dont: Never body or secondary text
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21 (worst-ground-wins): 5.66:1 on navy, 5.06:1 on card #232350, 4.51:1 on raised #2B2B5C (worst), AA normal text on every dark surface. Bar: AAA-minded AA; supersedes #8F8AA8 (4.46:1 on card, failed AA).

sage.$description: Muted green. CARRIED FROM THE APRIL IDENTITY pending a status-palette decision, success-state decoration only.

dont: Never text on ground — 4.33:1 fails AA... treat as non-text only
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 4.33:1 on ground, passes 3:1 non-text, fails AA normal text.

steel.$description: Muted blue. CARRIED FROM THE APRIL IDENTITY pending a status-palette decision, info-state chip wash only.

dont: Never text on ground — 2.87:1 fails every threshold, including 3:1 non-text
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 2.87:1 on ground, decorative wash only.

navy-60.$description: Navy card at 60% alpha. Top of dark-mode glass.

navy-48.$description: Navy card at 48% alpha. Mid dark-mode glass.

navy-32.$description: Navy card at 32% alpha. Light dark-mode glass.

steel-15.$description: Steel at 15% alpha. Info chip backgrounds (carried pending status-palette decision).

steel-30.$description: Steel at 30% alpha. Info chip borders (carried pending status-palette decision).

1.$description: Smallest step. Tight clusters, icon margins.

2.$description: Tight gap. Between related items in a cluster.

3.$description: Small gap. Card internal padding on compact items.

4.$description: Base step. Default spacing between text elements.

6.$description: Standard section gap. Used between related blocks.

usage: Gap between section and its subsections
Page section padding vertical on mobile

12.$description: Section-level gap. Between major page sections.

usage: Between hero and first content section

touch-target.$description: WCAG 2.5.5 AAA touch-target minimum. Floor for any interactive element on touch devices.

usage: min-height / min-width for buttons, inputs, tags, nav-links on touch
dont: Do not go below 44px on any touchable element — fails WCAG 2.5.5 AAA
bella.a11y: WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced) AAA requires ≥44×44px.

touch-target-comfortable.$description: Recommended touch-target for primary actions, a step beyond the AAA minimum.

mobile.$description: Mobile breakpoint. Single-column layouts below this width.

usage: max-width media query for phone layouts

tablet.$description: Tablet breakpoint. Two-column grids become feasible from here.

usage: min-width media query for tablet and up

desktop.$description: Desktop breakpoint. Standard multi-column editorial layouts.

usage: min-width media query for desktop layouts

wide.$description: Wide-desktop breakpoint. Editorial max-width and hero-scale type sizes.

usage: min-width media query for large screens

lg.$description: Large radius. Cards, raised surfaces, and the keycap plate.

xl.$description: Extra-large radius. card.default, inner panels, hero images.

2xl.$description: 2× large radius. Elevated glass cards; the portfolio card radius.

3xl.$description: 3× large radius. Feature / hero glass surfaces.

display.$description: Display typeface, Unique, the condensed identity face. Bold (700) cut only. Display headings, the home hero headline, and the keycap brand lockup, nothing else.

usage: Display headings (hero / page / section / case tiers)
dont: Never below 24px except the keycap logo (recorded exception)
Never for body, UI text, card titles, eyebrows, meta, nav links, buttons, or chips
Never negative tracking — Unique glyphs collide; display sizes always track ≥ 0

body.$description: Body and UI typeface, Geist. Everything Unique doesn't carry: body, labels, eyebrows, buttons, navigation.

dont: Do not add a third face — the type lock is exactly two

mono.$description: RETIRED as a distinct face (2026-07-17): the eyebrow look is caps + tracking, not a third family. Token kept and repointed to Geist so legacy consumers keep rendering.

usage: Legacy references only — new work should reference font-family.body
dont: Do not reintroduce a mono family — the type lock is exactly two faces

tag.$description: Floor for tags and small labels. Never go smaller.

dont: Never below 13px anywhere in BELLA

sm.$description: Small text. Eyebrows, secondary captions, footnotes.

usage: Eyebrows (one ramp step up from tag — 13px read too quiet under display heads)
dont: Do not use for body copy

base.$description: Body text floor. Non-negotiable minimum for reading text in BELLA.

dont: Never below 16px for body

lg.$description: Large body. Lead paragraphs, long-form reading comfort.

2xl.$description: Heading-3 size, also the Unique display floor.

dont: Unique never renders below this size outside the keycap logo

6xl.$description: Hero display step (Elleta, 2026-07-22). One step above 5xl, continuing the ramp's doubling gaps (8, 8, 16, 32). Sized so a short Unique 700 uppercase title visually outweighs a Geist 700 32px section head; Unique's condensed proportions need the size to carry a page title.

bold.$description: Bold. All Unique display settings (Unique Bold is the only cut), headings, eyebrows, CTAs.

black.$description: Extra-bold. Geist-only emphasis weight, Unique has no 800 cut.

dont: Never on Unique — the face ships 700 only
Do not use for body or card titles — too heavy

tight.$description: Tightened tracking. Geist display sizes only, never Unique.

dont: Never on Unique — condensed glyphs collide below 0 tracking; Unique display always tracks ≥ 0

normal.$description: Default tracking, and the Unique display floor.

wide.$description: Loose tracking. Small labels without full caps treatment.

wider.$description: Very loose tracking. Uppercase eyebrows, the tracking IS the old mono look.

hero.$description: Hero display tracking (Elleta pick, 2026-07-22, from a three-way render at 6xl). Positive tracking that opens Unique's condensed letterforms at hero sizes; pairs with font-size.6xl. Unique never takes negative tracking.

sm.$description: Small icon. Inline with body text and tags.

lg.$description: Large icon. Feature rows, empty states.

usage: All standard hover and focus transitions

dont: Do not use on text transitions — feels unstable

hover-lift.$description: Default hover elevation delta for cards.

key-press.$description: Keycap :active sink onto the reduced plate.

xs.$description: Lightest frost. Hover hints, subtle backdrops.

sm.$description: Small frost. Content cards, modal backdrop.

lg.$description: Large frost. Primary glass card / hero panel.

sm.$description: Faint shadow. Resting card elevation on ground.

hover.$description: Card hover shadow, stronger than sm, lighter than lg.

usage: Card hover state, paired with motion.transform.hover-lift

soft.$description: 3-layer cool shadow. Default floating elevation for hero / feature glass.

layered.$description: 4-layer shadow, 3 drops + inset top highlight. Primary glass card.

card-default.$description: 2-layer drop + inset top highlight. Subtle content-panel elevation.

card-elevated.$description: 2-layer drop + inset top highlight. Elevated case-study card.

orb.$description: 3D orb depth, resting. Token lock 2026-07-17, the depth IS the system; do not flatten. One light source, upper-left.

usage: Orb elements at rest (home cluster, About portrait)

key-resting.$description: Primary keycap at rest: thin edge plate, small soft cast, inset upper-left glass highlight. Calm extrusion (button grammar v5).

key-hover.$description: Primary keycap hover: one step more lift.

key-pressed.$description: Primary keycap pressed: sunk onto the reduced plate (pair with motion.transform.key-press).

card-rest.$description: Card resting shadow, the one-card system's calm-at-rest cast. Directional (down-right) per the one-light-source rule.

card-rest-dark.$description: Card resting shadow on navy, deeper black-alpha cast (black alpha in shadows follows the orb-lock precedent).

background.$description: Default page background in light mode.

background-inverse.$description: Inverse dark section on a light page.

usage: full-bleed dark sections embedded in a light layout

surface.$description: Raised card surface on ground. Cards separate from the page by lift and warmth, not darkness.

surface-elevated.$description: Highest light surface. Same value as surface, light-mode elevation is shadow-borne (portfolio contract); dark mode steps values instead.

surface-inset.$description: Recessed surface on ground, wells, tracks, inset panels.

surface-inverse.$description: Raised surface inside dark embedded blocks on light pages.

surface-glass.$description: Primary glass surface. Ground shows through the warm white. Pair with border-glass-top, shadow.raised, and blur.surface.

a11y.contextRequirement: Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only. Do not stack glass over saturated fills.
Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only.

border-glass-top.$description: Top highlight on a frosted panel, mimics natural light on glass.

bella.name: Button
bella.description: Keycaps with real hierarchy: two colour treatments, three tiers, one primary per view. Labels are Geist caps, never Unique.
dont: Do not render more than one primary per view: the keycap is the single 3D moment
Do not use for filters, toggles, or sort: that is FilterChip / SegmentedControl / Select territory
Do not set labels in Unique at any size
Do not build a neutral keycap: that tier is retired
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22, worst-stop-wins on the plate gradient: primary label (text-on-accent) 5.66:1 on accent-raised-hi and 7.09:1 on -lo in light (AA / AAA); 8.18:1 and 6.65:1 in dark (AAA / AA). Secondary and tertiary labels are text-accent, 5.66:1 light / 6.65:1 dark (AA); the accent never sits on its failing ground. Focus ring independent of the trace. Hit area 44px minimum on every tier. Disabled uses text-muted on surface-inset, 4.67:1 worst (AA), with aria-disabled semantics from the native attribute.

restState.description: At rest the primary keycap is calm: plate, gloss, edge, resting key shadow, label. The trace ring and the rise are hover/focus affordances; the press is active-only. audit:quality asserts the invariants on every story rendering the component (root carries data-bella-component=button).

trace.$description: Trace ring colour on the keycap. 3.74:1 on ground, passes the 3:1 non-text minimum; the ring is a hover affordance, not text.

gloss.$description: Resting sheen. White alpha, the permitted translucent overlay; never a solid fill.

gloss-pressed.$value: linear-gradient(transparent 0 10%, color-mix(in srgb, white 12%, transparent) 10%, transparent 50%)

border-radius.$description: The keycap plate radius; the one control on the lg step.

bella.name: Card
bella.description: The one-card system: every card surface renders through this. Calm at rest, theme-aware by construction; the only fixed-light path is Peek, on purpose.
dont: Do not nest cards inside cards
Do not use for navigation, that's nav-link's job
Do not nest links or buttons inside an interactive card: the card is ONE link or ONE button
Do not build a fixed-dark card, no fixed-dark path exists; peek (fixed always-light paper on navy) is the one recorded fixed-context exception
bella.a11y: Interactive cards render as a single anchor or button: one tab stop, no nested interactives. Name a card via ariaLabel when its visible content isn't the right name; media is aria-hidden when ariaLabel is set. Focus shows a visible ring (asserted in CI, both themes). prefers-reduced-motion replaces the trace with a static accent ring.
bella.note: The variant token blocks elevated/glass/featured/inverse below predate the 0.3 Card and remain solely as value sources for the .bella-card-* utility classes emitted by build.py; they are NOT Card variants (the shipped API is default | peek; styling lives in Card.module.css). Their retirement rides on the glass-utility decision.

restState.description: CALM AT REST is a contract: only these layers may paint before hover/focus. audit:quality asserts the invariants on every story that renders the component (root carries data-bella-component=card).

invariants.note: the inner panel stays inside the wrapper; the grid double-surface class of bug

bella.name: Tag
bella.description: Uppercase tracked label (Geist, the mono face is retired). Categorizes a card, a project, a mood. Text-primary on a periwinkle wash is the canonical look.
dont: Do not set foreground to iris/periwinkle/steel/sage, accent and status colors are wash and border here, never label text
Do not place on saturated backgrounds without verifying the foreground contrast
bella.a11y: 13px floor. Foreground is text-primary (AAA against ground and the periwinkle-15 wash in both modes). min-height hits 44px, tap area via padding so the visual chip can stay small.

bella.name: Eyebrow
bella.description: Small tracked caps label above a heading (Geist; the mono token is retired and repointed). Signals context or category.
dont: Do not use as a heading, eyebrows complement a heading, never replace one
Do not hard-code accent color as the foreground, flow through text-accent so AAA enforcement stays centralized
bella.a11y: 13px floor. Foreground flows through semantic.text-accent (iris on ground 5.66:1, periwinkle on navy 6.65:1, AA text, AAA large; verified 2026-07-21).

bella.name: Input
bella.description: Text input. Geist on the card surface, warm border, iris focus ring (periwinkle in dark mode).
dont: Do not strip the border on default state, it's how inputs are recognizable
bella.a11y: Focus ring is 2px border-strong offset 1px. Label required, never use placeholder as label. min-height hits 44px for touch.

bella.name: Link
bella.description: Inline text link inside body copy.
dont: Do not use for primary navigation, that's nav-link
Do not rely on color alone, always underlined or weight-shifted on hover
bella.a11y: Ink foreground on ground passes AAA (16.06:1, verified 2026-07-21). Link affordance is underline; hover turns iris (5.66:1, AA).

bella.name: Nav Link
bella.description: Top-level navigation item. Geist, uppercase-lite. Active state reads as text-primary with a 2px accent underline, the accent is decoration, the text carries the letters.
dont: Do not mix nav-link and inline-link in the same cluster
Do not color-distinguish the active state with accent-colored text, use the accent underline token instead
bella.a11y: min-height hits 44px, critical for mobile nav. Active variant uses text-primary (AAA on ground and navy, verified 2026-07-21) with a 2px accent border-bottom as the affordance, the accent stays non-text decoration.

bella.name: Section
bella.description: A vertical slice of a page. Defines standard padding and gap for content blocks.
dont: Do not nest sections inside sections

bella.name: Modal
bella.description: Modal dialog scaffold. Backdrop blur over the page content, centered dialog surface above.
dont: Do not nest modals
Do not use for non-blocking UI, use a drawer or popover instead
bella.a11y: Focus trap required. Escape to close. aria-modal='true'. Backdrop blur must be gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference for AAA 2.3.3 compliance.
